newsitem.title: USA: Democrat Landrieu wins Louisiana Senate race.
newsitem.headline: Democrat Landrieu wins Louisiana Senate race.

text.p: Louisiana elected Democrat Mary Landrieu to the Senate over conservative Republican Louis "Woody" Jenkins, the CNN television network projected Tuesday.

Landrieu, a former state treasurer, campaigned as an abortion rights supporter in this heavily Catholic state where church leaders urged voters to cast their ballots for her opponent. The Senate seat came open this year with the retirement of popular Democratic Sen. J. Bennett Johnston.
